content: {"episode_id":"ep-05043","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring) for this episode. The clinical indication documents a patient presenting with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of symptomatic atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome, consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes I48.91, I49.5, and I49.9. Given the history of unexplained cardiac arrhythmias and the need to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous electrocardiographic data during daily activities. We request reconsideration of the outstanding balance of 692.33 on the basis of this documented medical necessity."}
